vocabulary.meaning_en: about a home: nice but small
vocabulary.note_ar: إذا قيل عن بيتك cute فهو لطيف لكنه صغير
vocabulary.note_en: Used for homes and flats: nice but on the small side.
vocabulary.example: They have a cute little flat near the park.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (place) pleasant and with its own special character; (person) easy to like, makes people feel good
vocabulary.example: The old house with the wooden floors was charming.

vocabulary.meaning_en: special, interesting qualities that make a place different
vocabulary.example: This old street has a lot of character.

vocabulary.meaning_en: real; true to its origin
vocabulary.example: The restaurant serves authentic Moroccan food.

vocabulary.meaning_en: stylish and sophisticated, with good taste
vocabulary.example: She has an elegant home with simple furniture.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very rich and luxurious; you can see a lot of money
vocabulary.example: The palace was opulent, with gold everywhere.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very comfortable and expensive
vocabulary.example: We stayed in a luxurious hotel.

vocabulary.meaning_en: so impressive that it makes you stop and stare
vocabulary.example: The sunset over the sea was stunning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: so big and beautiful that it almost stops your breath
vocabulary.note_en: Usually for nature and big places.
vocabulary.example: The view from the mountain was breathtaking.

vocabulary.meaning_en: rare, special and very beautiful
vocabulary.example: The rainforest has exquisite flowers found nowhere else.

vocabulary.meaning_en: bubbly, happy and full of energy
vocabulary.note_en: Like the bubbles in a fizzy drink.
vocabulary.example: My niece has an effervescent personality.

vocabulary.meaning_en: lively, happy and excited
vocabulary.example: She is always bubbly in the morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: shy, quiet and reserved; modest in behaviour and clothes
vocabulary.example: She was demure and spoke only when necessary.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not showing your feelings; speaking only when necessary
vocabulary.example: He is a reserved man, but very kind.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not showing too much; quiet about yourself
vocabulary.example: She always wears modest clothes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: relaxed and patient; not easily upset
vocabulary.example: My father is easygoing; he never shouts.

vocabulary.meaning_en: happy to listen to and think about new ideas
vocabulary.example: A good teacher is open-minded.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (conversation) fun
vocabulary.example: It was an enjoyable chat about football.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (conversation) nice and happy
vocabulary.example: We had a pleasant conversation about our families.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (conversation) you learned something new
vocabulary.example: Talking to the old doctor was enlightening.

vocabulary.meaning_en: interesting; it makes you want to be part of it
vocabulary.example: The speaker was very engaging.

vocabulary.meaning_en: attractive in a mysterious way
vocabulary.example: The smell of the spices was alluring.

vocabulary.meaning_en: pleasant to look at; it pulls attention
vocabulary.example: The new park is very attractive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: good-looking with strong features (usually men; also older women)
vocabulary.note_ar: يُقال للرجال غالبًا، وأحيانًا لامرأة ناضجة ذات ملامح قوية
vocabulary.note_en: Usually men; also a mature woman or one with strong features.
vocabulary.example: He was a handsome young man with a strong jaw.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not very good and not very bad; okay
vocabulary.example: The film was so-so.

vocabulary.meaning_en: extremely beautiful
vocabulary.example: What a gorgeous baby!

vocabulary.meaning_en: flexible and moving with grace, like an athlete
vocabulary.example: The gymnast was lithe and strong.

fine_lines.title: stunning vs breathtaking
fine_lines.explanation_ar: stunning شيء مذهل يجعلك تتوقف عن التفكير. breathtaking شيء كبير وجميل جدًا (غالبًا طبيعة) يكاد يوقف أنفاسك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Stunning stops your thinking. Breathtaking (often big nature) almost stops your breathing.

examples.sentence: The view of the desert at sunrise was breathtaking.

fine_lines.title: elegant vs opulent
fine_lines.explanation_ar: elegant أنيق وذو ذوق، ولا يعني بالضرورة الغنى. opulent فاخر جدًا وتظهر فيه الثروة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Elegant = stylish with good taste, not always rich. Opulent = very luxurious; you can see the money.

examples.sentence: Her small flat is simple but elegant.
The opulent house had marble floors and gold lights.

fine_lines.title: enjoyable vs pleasant vs enlightening
fine_lines.explanation_ar: محادثة enjoyable ممتعة. pleasant لطيفة ومُفرحة. enlightening تعلّمت منها شيئًا جديدًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: An enjoyable conversation is fun. A pleasant one is nice and happy. An enlightening one teaches you something.

examples.sentence: It was a pleasant talk about the new baby.

fine_lines.title: cute (place) vs cute (person)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: cute عن البيت تعني لطيف لكنه صغير. وعن الأطفال تعني لطيف وجميل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A cute home is nice but small. Cute children are sweet and pretty.

examples.sentence: Your apartment is cute, but where do you keep your bike?

expressions.phrase: It has a lot of character.
expressions.example: The old market has a lot of character.

expressions.meaning_en: It is so beautiful you stop breathing for a moment.
expressions.example: The view from the top takes your breath away.

expressions.meaning_en: rare; there is nothing else like it
expressions.example: This handmade carpet is one of a kind.
Knowing these words gives you a leg up.

questions.question: "Her personality was ___; she was bubbly and fun."
"He was very ___, with a strong jaw and high cheekbones."
"She tended to be shy and quite reserved." She was ___.
"It was the most ___ house in the city, full of gold and marble."
Your friend says your flat is "cute". What does she probably mean?
questions.explanation_ar: cute عن البيت = لطيف لكنه صغير.
questions.explanation_en: A cute home is nice but small.

questions.question: A conversation where you learned something new was ___.
"The view from the top of the mountain was ___."
questions.explanation_en: Breathtaking is for big, beautiful nature.

questions.question: A person who is relaxed and patient is ___.
Someone who listens to new ideas is ___.
questions.explanation_en: Open-minded = willing to think about new ideas.
